description: goo 2026-07-28 (calendar Phase 3 seam): PillarColumn.cells (advanced-mode บล็อก 4 เสา, Figma 634:8752) was string[] — a single glyph per เสา — but the DAY block draws each เสา as 3 layers (天干 stem / 地支 branch / 五行 ธาตุ), so 2 of 3 layers were missing from the contract. Bug-class the anchor owns: a PRESENTATION-driven data shape (the MAN block draws 1 glyph, so cells stored 1 glyph) that silently drops backend data and forces a contract-rewrite at API-time — the bazi engine sends stem+branch+element for BOTH the natal (MAN) and day (DAY) charts (四柱八字 is fully populated on both), so the shape must be shared, not per-block. Fix: PillarCell {stem,branch,element}; PillarColumn.cells: PillarCell[]; MAN and DAY both carry all 3 layers and the UI picks how many to draw per kind (single shape = adapter maps backend→cells 1:1 at API-time, no UI rewrite). Fixture element is DERIVED from stem via 五行 so a mock cell is never internally inconsistent. Teeth (mutation-proven, npx tsx scripts/calendar-pillar-shape.test.ts): baseline 5/5; mut-A element:'' (drop the 3rd layer) -> three-layer-non-empty + 五行 tests CAUGHT (3/5); mut-B mislabel 庚->ไฟ (should be ทอง) -> 五行 data-correctness test CAUGHT (4/5, precise); both reverted by hand (untracked-safe), back to 5/5. NOTE: this PR's pages/v2/calendar/[date].tsx hunk is a TEMPORARY tsc-guard (the only consumer on main); Lamun's #137 removes that block, so it drops out on rebase after #137 merges — the durable change is types.ts + fixtures.ts. gate_layer=logic/contract-shape.
